description: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库、配置多节点环境、启动 MIND 模型评估

commands.name: 删除旧的 MiniOneRec 目录
commands.description: 如果已存在则删除，确保干净克隆

commands.name: 计算 CF 分数 (如果 cf_alpha > 0)
commands.description: 仅在 cf_alpha > 0 时运行 item-based CF 评分
commands.command: if python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(0 if float('{cf_alpha}') > 0 else 1)"; then echo '=== 计算 CF 分数 ===' && python src/compute_cf_scores.py --train_behaviors {data_root}/train/behaviors.tsv --eval_behaviors {data_root}/{split}/behaviors.tsv --output {data_root}/{split}/cf_scores.tsv --max_history {max_history} && echo 'CF scores saved to {data_root}/{split}/cf_scores.tsv'; else echo '=== 跳过 CF 评分 (cf_alpha=0) ==='; fi

commands.name: 启动模型评估
commands.description: 根据 eval_type 选择 pointwise 或 ranking 评估，可选 CF 混合
commands.command: EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR=$(dirname {model_path})/eval_results && mkdir -p $EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR && if [ "{eval_type}" = "pointwise" ]; then CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE=small DATA_ROOT={data_root} USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE={use_chat_template} USE_ABSTRACT={use_abstract} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE={batch_size} CF_SCORES_FILE={data_root}/{split}/cf_scores.tsv CF_ALPHA={cf_alpha} OUTPUT_FILE=$EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR/{split}_pointwise_predictions.txt bash scripts/eval_mind_pointwise.sh {model_path} {split}; else CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE=small DATA_ROOT={data_root} USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE={use_chat_template} USE_ABSTRACT={use_abstract} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE={batch_size} OUTPUT_FILE=$EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR/{split}_ranking_predictions.txt bash scripts/eval_mind_ranking.sh {model_path} {split}; fi && echo 'Evaluation results saved to' $EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR/

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.description: 保持容器运行以便进入调试，完成后可手动取消任务
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行，可通过 AML Portal 进入容器调试 ===' && sleep infinity
